units.tex: 应用商的极限法则时必须保证分母的极限存在且为非零实数。
令 $f(x)=x$、$g(x)=x^2$，当 $x\to0$ 时二者极限都是 $0$。直接用商的极限法则得 $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)/g(x)=0$。

rendering_contract.instruction: The renderer collects linked exercise solution units into the final answer section, regardless of their JSON order, when exercise_answers_at_end is true. Do not infer an answer-placement violation from unit order alone. Answers embedded in exercise.tex are NOT relocated and must still be reported. This contract is not evidence of mathematical correctness or final PDF acceptance.
